Description: A 2.5-ton compressor skid was lifted over an active process hydrocarbon line without a designated drop zone or tag lines. The secondary lifting sling showed severe fraying.
Contractor entered chemical storage vessel T-104 without continuous atmospheric gas monitoring or an assigned standby rescue person outside the manway.
Work commenced on 415V switchgear without Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) isolation or verification of zero energy state. The live busbar was left exposed.
Worker was observed unhooked at a height of 8.5 meters on an incomplete scaffold platform lacking toe boards and mid-rails.
Oxy-acetylene cutting performed within 3 meters of an un-isolated solvent line. No fire watch or spark containment blankets were deployed.
Forklift operated at high speed in the warehouse aisle with an obstructed forward view, narrowly missing a pedestrian crossing the marked walkway.
Corroded chemical transfer hose ruptured under 4 bar pressure during sulfuric acid transfer, spraying acid into the secondary containment pit.
Ex-rated junction box in Zone 1 hazardous area was left open with damaged flameproof seals during live transmitter loop testing.
Rotating pump coupling guard was removed while motor test run was in progress to inspect shaft alignment without stopping the drive.
Maintenance crew verified full 7-step LOTO, calibrated 4-gas detector, and wore all mandatory 100% tie-off PPE before commencing flare header inspection.
